supersessions.canonicalText: `DEC-07`: grenade families are now `frag`, `smoke`, `flash`, `semtex`; still exactly one selected, one spawned, cap one, kills do not replenish, the valid corpse-ammo-pickup transaction restores exactly one.
`DEC-13`: `deathClearsUnconsumedRewards` is `false`; progress remains per-life and resets on death; earned unconsumed rewards remain until consumed or match epoch end.
Human-facing graphics presets: `Quality`, `Performance`, `Max`, `Custom`. Internal quality tiers may exist only as resolved settings/benchmarks, not as a contradictory top-level choice.

`DEC-14` is not weakened by the request for a stronger flash. The effect is one strong bounded onset plus monotonic recovery, never a repeated full-screen strobe; reduced-sensory precedence and peak-limited audio remain mandatory.
Pass 65 owner HITL will apply only to a new immutable replacement `S0`; the failed `ec8a55f…` preview cannot be retrospectively approved after runtime edits.

Renderer quality profiles are presentation-only. They may reduce texture resolution, shadow/particle/decal/LOD budgets or non-authoritative minor debris, but may not remove/substitute semantic structures while retaining their colliders, or otherwise change cover, LOS, navigation, movement, ballistics or target visibility.
Every support asset declares and validates its modelling-axis conversion once. Route code uses the canonical forward axis; ad-hoc sign flips in individual abilities are forbidden.

Drone visual and weapon identity are shared by catalog projection, not copy-pasted: Swarm and standalone variants reference the same asset family and `DroneGunProfileId`; variant policy may change control mode, reserve and lifetime only where already frozen.

Runtime map previews supersede the earlier live-render interpretation of R112–R114: authored paths remain offline video-generation inputs and evidence, while the shipped menu plays prerecorded compressed media and submits no gameplay frames.
Atomic Acres reinforcement cadence is one added opponent per ten defeated bots, starting from the existing two and capped at six; the old fifth-death wording is retired.
Support HUD damage feedback is target-bound world projection. Centre-reticle damage numbers remain valid for the player's own camera-centred firearm hit only, not remote/AI support damage.

`DEC-16` freezes the four human-facing graphics labels as `Performance`, `Quality`, `Max`, `Custom`; the former Quality value migrates to Max, named profiles default uncapped, and Custom seeds from the last named profile before an explicit atomic save. This supersedes every three-choice top-level graphics statement.

`DEC-13` Drone Swarm calibration is exactly 24 drones, distributed into divergent individual/small-group routes with fast behind-caller ingress and a smooth normal-speed blend. The earlier exactly-12 calibration is retired.

`DEC-13` killstreak earning repeats the selected ladder after its final threshold while the same life remains active. Each reward is once per cycle, not once per life; death still resets progress while already earned unconsumed rewards survive until use or epoch end.

Shared `F` arbitration now gives an eligible nearby world interaction—care-crate collection, door, weapon pickup or future catalogued sibling—priority over support enter/exit. Support toggle wins only when no higher-priority world candidate is eligible; competing raw listeners remain forbidden.

Prerecorded preview media must depict the actual selected production arena, including unique real-map landmarks. Offline proxy scenes, another arena, placeholder imagery and live menu rendering all fail, strengthening supersession 9.

Care Package and Carpet Bomber activate from the admitted crosshair ground hit with no overview map. Carpet Bomber retains its corridor telegraph, uses exactly three times the preceding authoritative impact-damage profile and visibly drops bomb shells with bounded explosion/smoke/fire audiovisual presentation.

`DEC-07` now also freezes impact-instant, no-beep Smoke and actor-sticky Semtex. Actor-stuck Semtex uses exactly two-times blast damage and two-times blast radius and emits a current-life `STUCK` victim alert.

`DEC-08` explosive crossbow speed is 108 m/s, exactly three times the prior 36 m/s baseline. An actor-stuck bolt emits `STUCK` and uses exactly two-times blast damage and two-times blast radius; the prior slow-bolt profile is retired.

`DEC-13` Piloted Drone and Drone Swarm deployment now originates from deterministic valid centre-map spawn volumes with distributed separation. This supersedes the behind-caller ingress rule while retaining the 24-unit Swarm count, targetability, bounded navigation and divergent individual/small-group routes.

`DEC-13` standalone Piloted Drone manual movement is exactly 30% of the inspected 10 m/s baseline, therefore 3 m/s; autonomous movement remains exactly twice manual at 6 m/s. Drone Swarm ingress and patrol are independent catalog values and are not multiplied or reduced by this change.

Shared `F` arbitration is now a pinned press lifecycle rather than an immediate keydown priority. Releasing before 1,000 ms performs the winning eligible tap world action; reaching 1,000 ms performs eligible Piloted Drone or Chopper Gunner enter/exit with visible progress. Exactly one action commits, and keyup, blur, death, epoch, range or LOS invalidation cancels stale work. This supersedes supersession 15 and the earlier continuous care-capture interpretation.

Solo skirmish initial enemy count is exactly one on every bot-enabled arena. Arena-specific reinforcement cadence, hard caps and hosted-lobby bot choices remain separately catalogued; graphics profiles may never alter any count.

Smoke authority and presentation share one frozen volume contract: semantic radius is 150% of the inspected baseline, lifetime is deterministically sampled within five to ten seconds, one replicated readable colour is selected per activation, and admitted bullet corridors affect the same semantic density queried by humans and bots.

Background browser lifecycle never promises hidden rendering cadence that Chromium does not provide. Generation-owned fetch/decode/preparation may continue where permitted, hosted authority uses only its minimum fixed-step/network path, offline simulation pauses, presentation submits no hidden frames, and one coalesced foreground recovery resumes the existing admission.

Shed damage calibration is explicit: one admitted grenade causes major collapse and a Carpet Bomber strike obliterates the shed within bounded persistent-debris budgets. The door remains interactive only while its authoritative support structure exists, then detaches into the same physical lifecycle.

Glass lifecycle is authoritative across presentation, collision and ballistics. Intact and cracked panes block projectiles; only an admitted simultaneous break or pre-existing breached aperture permits pass-through, and detached panes cannot retain intact collision or damage state.

`DEC-13` drone combat balance now separates the variants: Piloted Drone per-hit damage is exactly `0.5 *` the inspected shared baseline and Drone Swarm per-hit damage is exactly `3 *` that baseline. The variants retain one authored visual asset family, but the earlier identical immutable gun-profile requirement is retired for damage; ammo, cadence, control, lifetime and feedback remain explicit per variant.

Support possession no longer uses hold-`F`. After activation, pressing the same currently bound killstreak slot key again toggles Piloted Drone or Chopper Gunner entry/exit exactly once; in the inspected binding these are slots `4` and `6`. `F` remains the tap-only world interaction coordinator. This supersedes the support-hold portion of supersession 22 and the support-toggle clauses in R504, R507 and R609 without weakening world-interaction priority.

The next player-facing correction candidate is `69.3`; Live remains `69.1` until that exact immutable preview is approved, and the rejected `69.2` candidate remains regression evidence only. This supersedes HF-213's `69.1` correction target without changing the internal `PASS 69` acceptance lane or the protected Stable/Rollback source pins.

`HF-220` is reopened and remains blocked on the manual first-person arms reauthoring and exact-preview owner HITL defined in `docs/PASS69_3_FIRST_PERSON_ARMS_REAUTHORING_PLAN_2026-08-10.md`; prior handedness, material, framing and socket-distance work does not establish acceptable anatomy, deformation or grips.

`HF-227` is reopened for Pass 70 because the owner still finds the Gun Range test-bay door lighting, texture and mapping insufficient; the earlier aligned-block implementation does not establish the requested authored finish.

`HF-233` strengthens the earlier ADS clearance interpretation: only the bounded physical reticle/sight aperture may become clear or open. Making the Carbine, receiver or unrelated weapon parts see-through is explicitly rejected even if the centre ray becomes visible.

`HF-249` supersedes the former generic labelled-DPS-row presentation in `HF-211`: the same canonical DPS formula remains, but its player-facing result is now a large standalone value with no bar above five ordered Damage, Fire Rate, Falloff/Range, Control and Piercing/Wallbang bars on both desktop and mobile.

Pass 69 at source `685ed7865018e107df5acf6cb6f7498b4468940c` is now the immutable live starting benchmark; `HF-252` makes Pass 70 the next correction candidate and supersedes `HF-232`'s 69.3/current-69.1 release wording without changing the byte-exact Pass 63 Stable contract or the requirement for local exact-SHA HITL before publication.
